## Achievements

You

- [ ] can explain the general idea of the relation of a model and the real world 
- [ ] can distinguish different purposes of models
- [ ] have an idea what "All models are wrong, but some are useful" means
- [ ] can relate different terminolgy under the general idea of *Models to learn from data*
- [ ] know how a line is modeled mathematically and what intercept and slope are
- [ ] can explain Simpson's paradox
- [ ] can explain different sampling strategies for surveys
- [ ] know what a latent variable is
